overall_goal: Tidy up the kitchen by putting away ingredients and clean dishes, while occasionally checking the food

goals.description: Throw away the discarded wrapper into the bin
goals.rationale: The person picks up a wrapper from the countertop and throws it into the bin.

goals.description: Check the food and adjust the burner temperature
goals.rationale: The person checks the boiling water, adjusts the hob temperature multiple times, and handles the cooking spoon.

goals.description: Taste the mixture and clean the teaspoon
goals.rationale: The person uses a teaspoon to taste the food, taps it to remove sauce, and repeatedly rinses it under the tap before placing it away.

goals.description: Put away the ingredients into the cupboard and fridge
goals.rationale: The person closes the Worcestershire sauce and minced garlic jars, then stores them in the cupboard and fridge respectively.

goals.description: Put away clean dishes from the drying rack into the cupboard
goals.rationale: The person takes dry muffin trays and plates from the drying rack and places them into the cupboards.

goals.description: Put away clean cutlery from the drying rack
goals.rationale: The person gathers spoons and knives from the drying rack and organizes them into the cutlery drawer and storage rack.

goals.description: Put away clean utensils from the drying rack
goals.rationale: The person collects larger utensils like a spatula and pan grippers from the drying rack and places them into the utensils drawer.
